prompts.south:
Use case: style-transfer.
Draw ONE FRONT head game texture of Vertin. TRANSPARENT background. The two images have different roles:
IMAGE 1: the existing MIS_arknights RimWorld pawn textures. Use the THORNS head (second column) as the PRIMARY DRAWING STYLE model: its heavy dark contour, compact clean face shape, simple eye rendering, discrete matte hair colors, and large legible hair locks. Texas reinforces the limited game-sprite color areas. Do not draw a detailed standalone anime illustration.
IMAGE 2: original Vertin portrait. Use ONLY her identity: short ash-beige/gray hair with swept forelock, muted gray-green eyes, pale skin, black-plum top hat, blue-gray band/bow with two ribbon tails and black tips. The floating hat is worn on the head.
The requested correction is STRONGLY LESS BABY-CHIBI. Draw a composed young adult woman's head: a noticeably longer narrow oval face, tapered jaw, a distinct small chin, restrained cheek volume. Eyes are higher on the face, small low almond shapes with small gray-green irises, just a small highlight dot at most, calm straight brows. Longer lower face between eye line and chin than a baby avatar. Visible face about 50 game pixels wide by 50 game pixels tall, not a wide short 60x35 face. Preserve the character's serious expression and elegant features, not a smile.
Draw AS AN ACTUAL SMALL GAME SPRITE at approximately 100 game pixels of head width enlarged for delivery. Bold nearly-black exterior outline about 1.5–2 game pixels; hair-lock divisions about 1 game pixel. Hair in only THREE main flat matte gray-beige tones with 6–8 major locks. Do NOT draw many pale strand streaks or fine wispy curls. One sweeping asymmetric forelock and a few short hooks at cheeks/nape carry her identity. Flat pale skin with one modest shadow color, no blush, no airbrush, no gradients. Hat plum-black in TWO flat tones, band/bow blue-gray in THREE flat tones. Compact hat crown, broad brim only slightly wider than hairstyle, modest two ribbon tails. No realistic reflective hat, no silky high-gloss hair. No ornamental micro-detail. This should look like it was drawn by the same game artist as the reference texture heads.
Straight-on orthographic front view, face level and upright, human ears. Hat bow on viewer RIGHT. HEAD ONLY, no neck, shoulders, collar, clothing, body or limbs. Full hat/hair/ribbon edges inside square canvas with transparent margins. No labels, grid, letters, ground shadow or checkerboard.

The corrected head is a young adult woman with a longer tapered oval/angular face, narrow cheek volume and distinct small chin. Small low gray-green almond eye, minimal iris detail, eye line relatively high and longer lower face. No baby round cheeks or round glossy eyes.
IMPORTANT STYLE: strong dark game-sprite external ink contour, about 1.5–2 pixels at a native 100-pixel head, hair-lock lines about 1 pixel; 6–8 BIG readable clumps of ash-beige hair, 3 matte colors, NO fine strand painting, NO fluffy wisps or fine ringlets, NO shiny hair, NO airbrush skin or painterly realism. Skin one pale fill and one subtle shadow, hat 2 dark plum tones, band/ribbons 3 smoky blue-gray tones. Match the flat readable silhouette and line weight of the supplied reference pawn textures. No new invented ornaments.
Keep front design's low dark plum TOP HAT, gently tilted broad oval brim just wider than hair, smoky blue-gray band/bow and two ribbons ending in black tips. Hair: swept forelock and short uneven cheek/nape hooks.
Single head only including hat and ribbons. All parts inside transparent canvas with clear margin. No neck, collar, body, shoulders or limbs. No text, grid, floor, shadow or background. Face/head level and upright.
Required direction: EXACT RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, not three-quarter, one eye. Small defined nose and longer adult jaw below eye line, not a baby's protruding round cheek. Bow on CHARACTER'S LEFT side is visible behind near ear. Brim points right. Keep the newly simplified few-lock hair structure and bold contour. No ponytail, no forward head tilt.
